get.description:
Last 10 git commits for the ticker.

The request never runs git itself and never waits on it once a list exists:
it answers from the cache and, when the cache is older than the TTL, starts
ONE background refresh in a thread. git on this repo can take longer than
its 5 s budget while a deploy rewrites the checkout; that used to raise
TimeoutExpired straight out of the handler (500) after blocking the event
loop for up to 15 s, and every worker retried on the next request
(2026-10-02). Now a slow git costs one thread and the ticker shows the
previous list.

post.description:
Historical what-if backtest of an ad-hoc basket idea.

Read-only: no card is created, no ledger or on-chain writes, no money
moves. Reuses the same engine (run_basket_backtest) as the saved-card
backtest, so an idea and a published card with the same basket return
identical numbers.

Two distinct exclusion lists in the response:
  * ``unresolved_symbols`` — constituents we couldn't map to a price
    source at all (bad/unknown ticker, or a crypto leg with no
    coingecko_id we could resolve).
  * ``dropped_symbols`` — resolved to a price source fine, but had no
    price history in the requested window (newly listed, etc.); weights
    renormalized over the rest.

``requested_weight_covered`` (0..1) is ALWAYS in the response — the
fraction of the basket's requested weight that actually priced. If it
falls below 80% the endpoint returns 422 INSUFFICIENT_BASKET_COVERAGE
instead of a headline return that would describe a different
(substitute) basket than the one requested (ET-25808 — a published
8-leg basket that lost 6 legs to unresolved/no-data equities
previously renormalized onto the 2 survivors and returned a -85%
"card result" that was really a 98.5%-weighted single equity leg).

get.description:
What a MARKET order on this book would be placed as, right now. Public, read-only.

A market order is never sent to the book open-ended: it is converted to an immediate-or-cancel
limit at the reference price plus (buy) or minus (sell) the protection percentage, and it is
refused outright when the book's own top is further than the sanity band from an independent
reference. This runs that same conversion and places nothing, so the worst price an order can
fill at is known before it is sent (ET-26151). The answer is a snapshot: the order itself
re-runs the conversion when it arrives.

kind.description: Only when no day is ahead: unknown (no schedule read on any feed) or none_scheduled (a schedule was read and nothing is ahead).

next_unlock_counted_from.description: ISO time the next unlock's days were counted from (the moment of serving, on REST, batch, MCP and the socket alike).

out_by_month.description: ET-31267: tokens out at the end of each month = circulating + scheduled unlocks + emissions - buybacks - burns; empty when no schedule is published.

market_as_of.description: ET-31644: present when the price and market cap were brought up to the Gem Screener's newer reading at serving time (one market cap on card and drawer).

supply_gap.description: Max supply minus total supply: not issued yet or burned (no feed says which).

staking_contradicted.description: Set when the feed's staked amount cannot sit beside the circulating and total supply (together they exceed the tokens that exist); the stake is then not used and named unknown.

dilution_week_pct.description: New tokens of the next 30 days at today's price, as % of market cap a week.

inputs.description: Every figure used, with its source and date.

source_unknown.description: The unknown inputs as the sources named them.

yearly_pct.description: Secondary flow figure: (in - out) x 12 / circulating-and-unlocked supply, in %. Null when no schedule is published.

yearly_range_parts.description: What makes the range as wide as it is.

slices_today.description: Flow internals: today's split of the supply by state.

months.description: One row a month from today to the last scheduled event (24-60): ts, label, pile, in {vesting, locks_ending, emissions, unstaking, total}, out {buyback, burn, staking, total}, slices, reserve, yearly_pct, yearly_range, tranches.

On the perp path (short_execution 'perp') there is NO paper book: paper=true is REFUSED with 400 PERP_NO_PAPER_BOOK, and an account in simulation_mode that omits it is refused with 400 ACCOUNT_IN_PAPER_MODE — a paper request is never downgraded to a real-ledger position. covered_call_income_enabled.title: Covered Call Income Enabled
covered_call_income_enabled.description: Enable Covered-Call Income: the bot writes a call against each OPEN BULL event-card lot it holds (BlackRock IBIT Premium Income style), harvesting premium and auto-rolling each expiry. Paper unless the underlying lot is live. No naked writing.

arb_strategy_enabled.title: Arb Strategy Enabled
arb_strategy_enabled.description: Enable the built-in ET10 DEX⇄CLOB arbitrage strategy: the bot compares the ET10 internal-CLOB price against the best executable price across the five mainnet ET10 DEX pools and, when the spread beats all fees+gas, trades BOTH legs with YOUR own custodial funds (atomic-or-neither, no shorting, no platform funds). Uses your bot's own USDC/ET10 balances; on-chain ET10 transfers incur the ET10 reward-pot cost.

covered_call_income_filters.title: Covered Call Income Filters
covered_call_income_filters.description: Covered-call filters: strike_mode ('ATM'/'OTM_5'/'OTM_10', default 'OTM_5'), roll_enabled (bool, default true), min_lot_notional_usdc (USDC, default 2.00 — skip lots too small to cover a contract), max_active_strategies (int 1-100, default 25 — cap concurrent written calls).

glassnode_trading_enabled.title: Glassnode Trading Enabled
glassnode_trading_enabled.description: Enable the on-chain (Glassnode, BYO-key) gate: trades are only taken while the configured on-chain condition(s) hold. Fails closed on missing key/data.

glassnode_filters.title: Glassnode Filters
glassnode_filters.description: On-chain gate config. Single condition: metric_category, metric_name, asset (default BTC), interval (default 24h), operator ('<'|'<='|'>'|'>='), threshold (float). Multi-condition (ET-14374): {logic: 'AND'|'OR', conditions: [up to 5 single-condition objects]}.

min_ai_confidence.title: Min Ai Confidence
min_ai_confidence.description: Universal minimum AI-signal confidence (0-1) before the bot opens ANY trade in venues that carry a confidence signal (event-card |sentiment|, catalog strategy confidence). null/0 = off.

strategy_override.title: Strategy Override
strategy_override.description: Per-instance base-strategy override (ET-15226): 'none' = run with NO base strategy (research/verifier bots — perpetual-epoch and catalog lanes place no trades, no strategy chip shown); 'inherit' or null = restore the template strategy; a live strategy symbol (e.g. 'HELIX', 'CORR') pins the perpetual lane to that exact versioned strategy (ET-17247 Phase 2).

auto_resume_after_stop.title: Auto Resume After Stop
auto_resume_after_stop.description: After a stop-loss / take-profit / breakeven / trailing-floor pause the bot starts a new risk episode by itself one epoch later (baseline re-armed from the current balance, lifetime P&L kept, a trading_resumed event written) — the same re-arm as pressing Resume. true = always, false = stay paused until you resume, null = the default for the mode (paper bots ON, live bots OFF).

trailing_floor_pct.title: Trailing Floor Pct
trailing_floor_pct.description: Opt-in HWM/trailing profit floor (ET-17247 Phase 3): once episode P&L peaks above this %, giving back more than this % from the peak pauses trading, and a proposed stake whose full loss would cross the floor is resized down or rejected pre-trade. null = off.

min_volume_24h_usd.title: Min Volume 24H Usd
min_volume_24h_usd.description: Per-bot liquidity floor (ET-15536): skip any catalog vehicle whose platform 24h traded volume (USD) is below this. Unknown/never-traded volume counts as 0 (fails closed — the bot never opens orders on illiquid assets). null = off. Suggested default: 500.

max_open_positions.title: Max Open Positions
max_open_positions.description: Cap on the bot's simultaneously OPEN tracked positions across venues. null/0 = unlimited.

sector_exposure_caps.title: Sector Exposure Caps
sector_exposure_caps.description: Per-USER (applies across ALL your bots) sector exposure caps, {sector: max_pct}. Sectors: ai, layer-1, defi, memes, stablecoins, crypto-other, equities, etf-fund, event-cards, prediction-markets, other. A new trade is blocked when the combined open notional of all your bots in that sector would exceed max_pct of your combined bot portfolio. {} clears.

the column, and the symbol it is locked to (apps that take one).

synthetic_excluded.description: Rows matching the filters that are NOT ranked because they have no historical record (data_kind synthetic/none/unknown). Pass include_synthetic=1 to list them, each labelled by data_kind.

src__api__routes__clob__PlaceOrderReques.title: PlaceOrderRequest
src__api__routes__clob__PlaceOrderReques.description:
CLOB order. LIVE BOOK ONLY — the CLOB has no paper book. `paper` is the
canonical control shared by every order surface: true is rejected (400
CLOB_NO_PAPER_BOOK), false places a REAL order, omitted = live UNLESS the
account is in simulation_mode, in which case the order is rejected (400
ACCOUNT_IN_PAPER_MODE) so a paper-mode caller never spends real balance by
omission — pass paper=false to trade live deliberately (ET-22652).

model_id.description: ID of the equipped model to backtest (optional for perpetual)

asset_id.description: data_source=catalog only: the exact catalog instrument picked, as returned by /backtest/catalog-assets (`crypto:<SYMBOL>` or `stock:<SYMBOL>`). Pins the candle series and is stored in the run record; omitted = the catalog's own classification of the symbol.

agent_symbol.description: Perpetual agent symbol (e.g. MOMO, DELTA) for perpetual

model_slugs.title: Model Slugs
model_slugs.description: List of ADM model slugs for ensemble backtest

num_runs.title: Num Runs
num_runs.description: Number of parallel runs (1-10). 3 free runs/day, then 1 BRRR per run.

ta_weight.title: Ta Weight
ta_weight.description: TA vs Labs blend weight (1.0=pure TA, 0.0=pure Labs)

oos_fraction.description: Out-of-sample share of the window, e.g. 0.3 = last 30% held out

confirmed_max_charge_usdc.description: Echo of quote.max_total_charge_usdc the caller accepted

confirmed_brrr.description: Echo of quote.brrr_required when no USDC conversion is needed

src__api__routes__cloned_bot__BacktestRe.title: BacktestRequest
src__api__routes__cloned_bot__BacktestRe.description: Request to start a backtest for an equipped model.

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: ID of the species/agent to clone

is_paper.title: Is Paper
is_paper.description: Explicit paper/live mode. If None, inherits user's simulation_mode.

paper.title: Paper
paper.description: Same as is_paper (canonical name shared with the event-card endpoints). true = paper clone, false = live clone, omitted = inherits the account's simulation_mode.

order_type.title: Order Type
order_type.description: limit, market, ioc, post_only, stop_limit, stop_market

position_id.title: Position Id
position_id.description: Optional position UUID — used by the EVCDX-* bridge to target a specific bull position on SELL when the user has multiple open positions on the same card.  Ignored for non-EVCDX symbols.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Trading mode: 'live' or 'paper'. Default 'live'. Resolution: if the account's simulation_mode is true the server FORCES paper whatever you send; if it is false this field decides, so omitting it places a REAL order. `paper` (below) is the same control under the name every order surface shares. Read your effective mode from GET /api/v1/portfolio/summary (simulation_mode) or GET /mcp/v1/agents/me (trading_mode) before relying on a default (ET-22652).

paper.title: Paper
paper.description: Canonical paper/live control shared by every order surface (event-cards `paper`, bot clone `paper`). true = paper, false = live; when given it overrides `mode`. Omitted: `mode` applies (default live), and an account in simulation_mode is forced to paper regardless.

stp_mode.title: Stp Mode
stp_mode.description: STP mode: cancel_resting, cancel_incoming, cancel_both, cancel_taker, decrement_and_cancel

time_in_force_ms.title: Time In Force Ms
time_in_force_ms.description: GTT: order auto-expires after this many ms (1s to 30d)

expire_at.title: Expire At
expire_at.description: GTT: absolute expiry as epoch microseconds (must be in the future)

display_qty.title: Display Qty
display_qty.description: Iceberg: visible quantity per tranche (remainder hidden)

route_mode.title: Route Mode
route_mode.description: Execution venue: 'auto' (default — CLOB, then the displayed DEX levels for anything marketable), 'cex' (explicit opt-out: CLOB only), 'dex' (AMM only)

dex_ack.title: Dex Ack
dex_ack.description: On-chain swap acknowledgement. An order that would execute through an on-chain swap from your own wallet (a market order whose reference is the on-chain quote, ANY limit on a DEX-backed market — it executes as a swap the moment the on-chain price reaches it — or route_mode=dex) is refused with HTTP 428 DEX_SWAP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED carrying the swap's price_now / worst_price / chain / venue until it is resent with dex_ack=true. Without it the order only ever trades against orders resting on this book (a market remainder is cancelled, a limit rests).

dex_ack_price.title: Dex Ack Price
dex_ack_price.description: The price_now you confirmed (from the 428 detail). If the on-chain price has moved more than 1% against you by the time the order arrives it is refused again with DEX_SWAP_PRICE_MOVED and the new price.

dex_fee_ack_usd.title: Dex Fee Ack Usd
dex_fee_ack_usd.description: The most network (gas) fee in USD you approve for the swap — send fee.max_network_fee_usd from the 428 detail. A DEX match settles on-chain and needs time to settle; it is never sent without this approval, and a resting remainder is never swapped while the current network fee is above it (DEX_SWAP_FEE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED).

BearerJWT.description: Account session JWT (from /auth/login). Key-management routes accept only this — never an API key.
